import { uv, vec2, vec3, vec4, float, texture, mix, mul, add, oneMinus } from 'three/tsl'
import { gsap } from 'gsap'

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new THREE.Group()
  
  // Atlas region
  const atlasRect = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 512, h: 320 }
  const aspectRatio = atlasRect.w / atlasRect.h // 1.6
  
  // Plane dimensions in scene units

  // Geometry

  // Font atlas
  const fontAtlas = ctx.fontAtlas
  const atlasTexture = fontAtlas.texture
  const atlasWidth = fontAtlas.width || 2048
  const atlasHeight = fontAtlas.height || 2048
  
  // UV offset for atlas region
  const uOffset = atlasRect.x / atlasWidth
  const vOffset = 1 - (atlasRect.y + atlasRect.h) / atlasHeight
  const uScale = atlasRect.w / atlasWidth
  const vScale = atlasRect.h / atlasHeight
  
  // Load ceramic grain texture
  const grainTexture = ctx.textureLoader('/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png')
  
  // Build material with TSL nodes
  const material = new THREE.MeshBasicNodeMaterial()
  material.transparent = true
  
  // UV nodes
  const uvNode = uv()
  
  // Transformed UV for atlas region
  const atlasUV = vec2(
    uvNode.x.mul(uScale).add(uOffset),
    uvNode.y.mul(vScale).add(vOffset)
  )
  
  // Sample font atlas (text content)
  const textSample = texture(atlasTexture, atlasUV)
  
  // Sample ceramic grain
  const grainSample = texture(grainTexture, uvNode.mul(3.0)) // tile a bit
  
  // Colors
  const inkColor = vec3(0x16/255, 0x16/255, 0x1d/255)
  const paperColor = vec3(0xe8/255, 0xec/255, 0xf2/255)
  const surfaceColor = vec3(0x0b/255, 0x0b/255, 0x10/255)
  
  // Engineered gradient: surface at top, ink at bottom
  const gradientT = uvNode.y.oneMinus() // 1 at top, 0 at bottom
  const gradientColor = mix(surfaceColor, inkColor, gradientT)
  
  // Subtle grain
  const grainAmount = float(0.07)
  const grainAdd = mul(grainSample.rgb, grainAmount)
  const surfaceColor_final = add(gradientColor, grainAdd)
  
  // Text mask: use the red channel of the atlas sample as alpha
  // For MSDF, the text is typically in the RGB channels with alpha = median
  // For pre-rendered text, use the alpha or luminance

    mesh.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion)

  group.add(mesh)

import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'
import { uv, texture, uniform, float, vec2, vec3, mix, mul, add, oneMinus, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl'
import { gsap } from 'gsap'

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  // Container group
  const group = new THREE.Group()
  group.position.set(0, 3, 0)
  group.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
  group.scale.set(1, 1, 1)
  
  // Atlas region
  const atlasRect = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 512, h: 320 }
  const aspectRatio = atlasRect.w / atlasRect.h
  
  // Plane dimensions in scene units
  const planeWidth = 2.8
  const planeHeight = planeWidth / aspectRatio
  
  // Geometry
  const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(planeWidth, planeHeight, 1, 1)
  
  // Font atlas from context
  const fontAtlas = ctx.fontAtlas
  const atlasTexture = fontAtlas.texture
  const atlasWidth = fontAtlas.width || 2048
  const atlasHeight = fontAtlas.height || 2048
  
  // Compute UV transform for atlas region
  // Note: Three.js UV origin is bottom-left, source rect uses top-left origin
  const uOffset = atlasRect.x / atlasWidth
  const vOffset = 1.0 - (atlasRect.y + atlasRect.h) / atlasHeight
  const uScale = atlasRect.w / atlasWidth
  const vScale = atlasRect.h / atlasHeight
  
  // Load ceramic grain texture (synchronous from cache)
  const grainTexture = ctx.textureLoader('/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png')
  grainTexture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping
  grainTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
  
  // --- TSL Material Setup ---
  const material = new THREE.MeshBasicNodeMaterial()
  material.transparent = true
  material.depthWrite = false
  
  // UV node
  const uvNode = uv()
  
  // Atlas UV: offset and scale to show the correct region
  const atlasUV = vec2(
    uvNode.x.mul(uScale).add(uOffset),
    uvNode.y.mul(vScale).add(vOffset)
  )
  
  // Sample font atlas (text content "Features")
  const textSample = texture(atlasTexture, atlasUV)
  
  // Sample ceramic grain with tiling
  const grainUV = uvNode.mul(2.5)
  const grainSample = texture(grainTexture, grainUV)
  
  // Colors
  const inkColor = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.055)     // #16161d
  const paperColor = vec3(0.910, 0.925, 0.949)    // #e8ecf2
  const surfaceColor = vec3(0.027, 0.027, 0.039)  // #0b0b10
  
  // Engineered gradient: surface (top) to ink (bottom)
  const gradientT = uvNode.y.oneMinus()
  const gradientColor = mix(surfaceColor, inkColor, gradientT)
  
  // Subtle grain overlay
  const grainAmount = float(0.06)
  const grainMod = mul(grainSample.rgb, grainAmount)
  const surfaceFinal = add(gradientColor, grainMod)
  
  // Text mask from atlas (use luminance/alpha)
  const textMask = textSample.a // alpha channel as text mask
  
  // Final composition: surface with text overlay
  const finalColor = mix(surfaceFinal, paperColor, textMask)
  
  // Opacity uniform for animation
  const opacityUniform = uniform(0)
  
  material.colorNode = finalColor
  material.opacityNode = opacityUniform
  
  // Create mesh
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material)
  mesh.renderOrder
